title: Ecolture
description: A slightly modded forever world/server. Feels almost vanilla Minecraft. No bloat, pure survival experience. Family friendly, all ages. Join our Discord server to get whitelisted.
body:
## [Apply in our Discord server first, we have whitelist enabled.](https://discord.gg/KCRYQZgYqZ)

Welcome to **Ecolture** a long-term Minecraft world designed for creativity, community, and lasting projects. This is not a fast-paced reset server. Build cities, villages, mega bases, roads, nations, or entire civilizations in a world meant to grow over time.

### Features
- 🆔 Whitelisted to keep the place safe
- 🌍 Enhanced world generation for better exploration
- 🌲 Falling Trees for faster wood gathering
- 🎙️ Proximity Voice Chat for immersive multiplayer
- 🛠️ Tool Trims to customize your gear
- 🧱 Vertical Slabs for expanded building possibilities
- 🏠 Long-term world no planned resets
- 🤝 Community-focused survival gameplay
- ⚙️ Light modded experience while staying close to vanilla

### Rules 1.2
1. No world resets. Ever.
2. No griefing or altering others’ builds without permission.
3. No stealing from players, bases, or chests.
4. PvP only if both players agree.
5. No hacked clients, dupes, or unfair exploits. (Only vanilla exploits like tripwire duping etc.)
6. Only admin-approved mods. No gameplay-changing content mods.
7. Keep chat, skins, builds, and names family-friendly.
8. Respect player projects, claims, and community areas.
9. No harassment, bullying, hate speech, or excessive toxicity.
10. No lag machines or intentionally harmful builds.
11. Admin decisions are final.
12. You will be kicked if inactive for 3 days or longer. (Without any excuse)

### How to Join
This server is **whitelist-only** to keep the community safe and long-term.
1. [Join the Discord server](https://discord.gg/KCRYQZgYqZ)
2. Read the rules and server information
3. Submit your username to get whitelisted
4. Wait for approval from staff
5. Once whitelisted, join the server and start playing
